# libXpm 3.5.19 in ZzXsrv

Imported from the official X.Org release archive on 2026-09-15.
`source-files.json` records the archive URL, SHA-256, upstream hashes and imported
hashes. `patches/windows.patch` records modifications to upstream files.

This is a modified distribution: local mhmake/config integration, pointer-width
hash conversions and Windows binary file reading are retained or corrected.
The public xpm.h is synchronized with this release. Its historical API number
30411 is also used by upstream 3.5.19; it is not the release package version.
